question: What is the per-axis roll-off (natural cell size) of the alignment and geo filters around truth?
hypothesis: The filter tube is anisotropic with a measurable per-axis cell size for grid search.
narrative_md: Per-axis perturbation map on 5 seeds: geo cost is the sharper filter (omega-dir basin ~1deg, q0 basin ~5deg); alignment cost is wide on q0/omega-dir but extremely tight on omega-mag (drops at any non-zero perturbation). The filter tube is anisotropic: q0 wide, omega-dir narrow, omega-mag narrowest. LS-bracket's ~5% omega-mag accuracy matches the alignment-cost omega-mag scale.
